overview: The Goranga Highlands are the tribal stronghold of the Goranga.
details: Warbands roam the ridges, hunting camps dot the landscape, and bone totems mark territorial boundaries. Grimlings and owlbears frequently trespass.
hooks: A Goranga warband prepares for a raid.
Owlbears encroach on the highland hunting grounds.
Grimlings attempt to steal Goranga bone totems.
A Goranga chieftain calls for warriors.
